record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; notebook code was not read or run. The README references a result image, but its contents are not available in the supplied text.
record.tranche_reason: The README explicitly calls this a reproduction of the original experiment, describes its difference-in-means direction and causal interventions, and reports qualitative outcomes.
record.gate_note: The README reports that adding the selected direction induces refusals on harmless prompts and ablating it suppresses refusals on harmful prompts. It gives no numerical outcomes. Candidate-direction selection details are method descriptions, not separate reported results; the referenced image was not inspected.
record.test_reason: The README calls this a reproduction of the original Figure 3 experiment on Gemma-2b-it. It uses the same difference-in-means extraction, bypass/induce selection, and addition/ablation interventions, and reports the refusal outcomes.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README concludes that the selected direction induces refusal on harmless prompts and suppresses it on harmful prompts, reproducing the paper's key finding and supporting the single-direction hypothesis.
record.recipe_differences: The README says it reproduces the original Figure 3 experiment, using harmful-minus-harmless mean activations and causal addition and ablation. This is a reproduction repository; its notebook was not inspected or run.
record.problems: Only qualitative outcomes are reported in the README; no numerical refusal rates, uncertainty, controls, or general-capability results are provided. The referenced result image and notebook were not inspected.
record.rows_left_out: No other reported outcomes in the supplied README. The referenced image was not inspected, and method details about extracting candidate directions and selecting the optimal direction are not result rows.

untested.parts: Preservation of other abilities (no capability checks), and whether ablation was applied at all layers and positions. Only one model (Gemma-2b-it); no quantitative refusal or safety rates in the README.

missing.what: The quantitative refusal and safety scores behind the reproduced Figure 3 (baseline vs. ablation vs. addition). These are only in the result image, which was not read.

record.verdict_notes: This is an unreviewed hobby reproduction (0 stars) on a single model. That model, Gemma-2b-it, is among the original paper's models, so it is a replication rather than a new setting. The record's limits_scope label was removed: the absence of a rate is not evidence that the effect needs qualifying. The verdict confidence is low because no numbers are given.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not establish whether ablation was applied at every layer and position or whether other abilities were preserved.
Weight-editing or abliteration in released models.
Whether attacks suppress the direction or training against its ablation improves robustness.
Whether refusal is better described by an affine set, cone, or multiple directions.
Whether harmfulness judgment is encoded separately from refusal.
Transfer across languages, model variants, or base-to-instruct models.
How refusal training determines whether a removable direction exists.

rows.operation_detail: Added the selected refusal direction during the forward pass.
rows.value: The README states that the direction induces refusal behavior on harmless prompts.
rows.note: Qualitative outcome only; no rate or other numerical result is given.
rows.check: No change to the state. The value is qualitative only, and the size (2B) is stated in the model name.

rows.subject: Gemma-2b-it
rows.operation_detail: Ablated the selected refusal direction during the forward pass.
rows.value: The README states that ablating the direction suppresses refusal behavior on harmful prompts.
rows.note: The README reports suppression, but does not state that refusal was fully removed or give a refusal rate.
rows.check: Marked partial only because no rate is given. The README says ablation 'suppresses refusal behavior' and calls this reproducing the key finding, which is no evidence that the effect was incomplete. The lack of a number lowers precision, not the state. The model name also states the size (2B), so size_stated could be '2b'.

relationships.condition: Gemma-2b-it; direction added on harmless prompts and ablated on harmful prompts
relationships.reason: The README reports induced refusal on harmless prompts (R1) and suppressed refusal on harmful prompts (R2). The evidence is qualitative only.
relationships.display_finding: Addition was reported to induce refusal on harmless prompts, while ablation suppressed refusal on harmful prompts.
